title: Seoul 5 Day Itinerary: Easy, No-Zigzag Plan
summary: A relaxed five-day Seoul itinerary that groups each day by area, with a palace walk, a Han River evening and an easy day-trip choice.

slides.title: Five Days, No Zigzag
slides.sub: Keep each day in one area
slides.voice: Five days in Seoul? Avoid zigzagging. Group stops.

slides.title: Five Days, Five Zones
slides.sub: North · markets · west · east · day trip
slides.voice: Five days, five zones: palace north, central markets, west, east, then one day trip.

slides.title: Palaces To The Stream
slides.voice: Start early at Gyeongbokgung, then walk Bukchon and Insadong. Finish beside Cheonggyecheon.

slides.title: Make The River Your Evening
slides.sub: Yeouido or Mangwon; fried chicken riverside
slides.voice: Walk Yeouido or Mangwon Hangang Park in the evening; locals order fried chicken to the riverbank.
slides.photo_query: Make The River Your Evening Korea

slides.title: Pick One Day Trip
slides.sub: Suwon solo; DMZ by organised tour
slides.voice: Suwon is an easy solo day trip. The DMZ needs an organised tour; bring your passport.
